subject: Final-stage stall: proposed MAP stabilizer sprint and acceptance bridge
messages:
From: tara.nguyen <tara.nguyen@bluepeak.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@bluepeak.com
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP timing concern — acceptance drift at final stage

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are broadly aligned on functionality, but our product team flagged a blocker in the final-stage integration test that will push our internal acceptance window out by ~2 weeks unless we do a short remediation sprint. That impacts the mutual action plan (MAP) dates and the planned go-live window.

Can Redwood propose a stabilization plan we can sign off on that limits spillover? We need:
- a short remediation scope (2–3 days) and who will own fixes
- a formal MAP update with new milestone dates and acceptance criteria
- options for minimal commercial protection if dates slip (credits or extended support)

I attached the latest MAP spreadsheet with highlights.

Best,
Tara Nguyen
Program Manager, BluePeak Systems
T: +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: BP_MAP_v2.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: tara.nguyen <tara.nguyen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timing concern — acceptance drift at final stage

Tara — thanks for the heads up and the file. We reviewed the highlighted failure and agree a short, targeted stabilizer sprint makes sense. Proposed immediate next steps:

1) Redwood stabilization sprint (3 business days) — scope: fix the integration edge case in the auth handshake + one regression pass. Owner: Grace (Infra).
2) New MAP milestone draft — shift Acceptance Window start by 14 calendar days; add a 5-business-day contingency buffer. Draft attached.
3) Commercial protection options — two choices: (A) 5% credit on first-month invoice if final acceptance slips beyond the new buffer, or (B) extended 30-day free priority support.

Laura, can you confirm procurement timelines if they pick option A vs B? Grace, can you own the sprint and give an ETA for a fix branch by EOD today?

Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
On Mon, Mar 8, 2027 at 09:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — I can own the sprint.
> Plan: isolate the auth handshake regression, build a fix branch and run the integration harness.
> ETA for patch: Wed 10 Mar 18:00 PT. If green, I'll push a canary to the BluePeak staging cluster Thu morning.
> I will keep the change small (config + 1 small handler change) to avoid cascade risk.
> 
> Grace
> Engineering Lead, Infra
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: tara.nguyen <tara.nguyen@bluepeak.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timing concern — acceptance drift at final stage

Tara — procurement note: if BluePeak selects option A (5% credit) we can route that as a one-time invoice adjustment and preserve the existing SOW milestones (with the new dates inserted into the MAP). Option B (30-day priority support) requires a short addendum to the MSA but is operationally simpler.

Two quick asks from our side:
- please confirm internally which option you prefer by Mon EOD 15 Mar so we can finalize SOW redlines
- share any failing test logs (screenshot/trace) if available — speeds triage.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_draft_redlines.pdf
From: tara.nguyen <tara.nguyen@bluepeak.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 07:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP timing concern — acceptance drift at final stage

Thanks all. We're leaning to Option B (30-day priority support) to avoid invoice changes — product leadership asked for the fastest path. Attached are the stack traces and a short failing test log.

We appreciate the scope limit (grace) and the proposed buffer. We still want a short risk log added to the MAP that captures: root cause, mitigation, owner, residual impact, and rollback criteria. Can Redwood add that to the MAP and send back the redlined sheet?

-Tara
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: tara.nguyen <tara.nguyen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 17:24:00 -0700
Subject: Final-stage stall: proposed MAP stabilizer sprint and acceptance bridge

Tara — quick status and final MAP deliverable:

1) Grace confirmed patch landed to a fix branch Wed 10 Mar at 17:48 PT; canary deployed to BluePeak staging Thu 11 Mar 08:15 PT. Staging regression pass is green.
2) Attached: updated MAP spreadsheet (BP_MAP_v2.xlsx) with a new section — "Final-stage risk log" — entries:
   - Root cause: intermittent auth handshake timeout under specific header ordering.
   - Mitigation: code handler fix + temporary staging config guard.
   - Owner: Grace O'Connor (Redwood).
   - Residual impact: 0-2 business days acceptance variance risk (low).
   - Rollback criteria: failed canary metrics > 0.5% error rate for 1 hour.
3) Acceptance Window: shifted +14 calendar days; added 5 business day buffer as requested.
4) Commercial: we'll proceed with Option B (30-day priority support) and will circulate the addendum draft for signatures by Tue 16 Mar.

Next actions:
- Tara: confirm acceptance of the updated MAP and the risk log by Tue 16 Mar.
- Laura: please prepare the addendum and a one-page summary of the credit fallback if BluePeak changes preference.
- Grace: please run a production smoke after cutover and report metrics H+24.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min touchpoint tomorrow if helpful.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650-555-0199

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4721
Attachments: BP_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_redlines.pdf
